1.web: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it is love or hatred, man doesn’t know it; all is before them.
1.asv: For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God; whether it be love or hatred, man knoweth it not; all is before them.

2.web: All things come alike to all. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good, to the clean, to the unclean, to him who sacrifices, and to him who doesn’t sacrifice. As is the good, so is the sinner; he who takes an oath, as he who fears an oath.
2.asv: All things come alike to all: there is one event to the righteous and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth and to him that sacrificeth not; as is the good, so is the sinner; and he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.

3.web: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all: yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
3.asv: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event unto all: yea also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.

4.web: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
4.asv: For to him that is joined with all the living there is hope; for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

5.web: For the living know that they will die, but the dead don’t know anything, neither do they have any more a reward; for their memory is forgotten.
5.asv: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not anything, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.

6.web: Also their love, their hatred, and their envy has perished long ago; neither have they any more a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun.
6.asv: As well their love, as their hatred and their envy, is perished long ago; neither have they any more a portion for ever in anything that is done under the sun.

7.web: Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
7.asv: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God hath already accepted thy works.

8.web: Let your garments be always white, and don’t let your head lack oil.
8.asv: Let thy garments be always white; and let not thy head lack oil.

9.web: Live joyfully with the wife whom you love all the days of your life of vanity, which he has given you under the sun, all your days of vanity: for that is your portion in life, and in your labor in which you labor under the sun.
9.asv: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of thy life of vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all thy days of vanity: for that is thy portion in life, and in thy labor wherein thou laborest under the sun.

10.web: Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.
10.asv: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, whither thou goest.

11.web: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.
11.asv: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.

12.web: For man also doesn’t know his time. As the fish that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falls suddenly on them.
12.asv: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare, even so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.

13.web: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.
13.asv: I have also seen wisdom under the sun on this wise, and it seemed great unto me:

14.web: There was a little city, and few men within it; and a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.
14.asv: There was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it.

15.web: Now a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
15.asv: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

16.web: Then I said, “Wisdom is better than strength.” Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
16.asv: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

17.web: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him who rules among fools.
17.asv: The words of the wise heard in quiet are better than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.

18.web: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.
18.asv: Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroyeth much good.
